summary: Layer 1B expansion found a mostly underfollowed set of US-listed second-order beneficiaries tied to private-label growth, retailer compliance, food-safety testing, and packaging formats. The strongest direct manufacturing exposure in this pass is Seneca Foods, while SPS Commerce maps to retail-supplier compliance plumbing, Neogen to food-safety testing systems, and TriMas to specialty packaging and closures. These are not recommendations; they are research candidates requiring later verification of customer concentration, retailer/private-label exposure, pass-through pricing, capacity utilization, and whether private-label growth is material enough to move earnings.
